Alisa Boyko is a U.S.-based classical fine artist with over 25 years of professional art experience. Her work celebrates the beauty, character, and quiet poetry of everyday life. Working almost exclusively from life, she creates portraits, still lifes, landscapes, and figure paintings that combine technical precision with a deep appreciation for light, color, and atmosphere.
